environment.nvidia_smi_after_note: post-run memory includes this process's own CUDA context (~600 MiB); other_processes_present flags external contention
environment.timed_section: clocks bracket the draw measurement loop (graph prebuilds and profiler excluded)

config_notes: config values from conf/model/neural_field_v2.yaml (GNO context encoder block)
parent-inferred fields set explicitly (required by GNOContextEncoderConfig._finalize): output_size, space_dim, positional_encoding, activation, dropout

n_conditioning_features left None -> vanilla LayerNorm (resolve_layer_norm_config(None)); adaptive_mlp_hidden_channels and conditioning_mlps_zero_init left None -> 'auto' zero-init inside the encoder; none required by validation
kernel MLP resolves to hidden [588, 588] (in 294 -> out 294); pe_pos=147, pe_dense=294 channels at num_frequencies=24
dropout=0.0 in config; eval mode asserted and recorded (dropout/norm flags)
device mechanism: explicit torch.device('cuda:7') + torch.cuda.set_device; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES not set (one mechanism, stated)
cache-hot regime: identical inputs re-used across reps, so activations sit in L2; production streams fresh data - absolute times are cache-hot
stage A timing brackets RadiusNeighborhood.forward, which contains a warp device synchronize; its CUDA-event pair covers GPU work plus that host sync
e2e = radius search + encoder forward inside one event pair, matching production where the radius_neighborhood block runs inside the model forward
inputs fp32; the bf16 arm wraps calls in torch.autocast(bfloat16) (production AMP); PE internally disables autocast and runs fp32

quadrature: production area-weights the GNO via dense_surface_quadrature (conf/model/neural_field_v2.yaml); this run passes uniform 1/N_g weights of shape (1, N_g, 1) at all three timed call sites (e2e encoder forward, stage-B integral, split cross-check) - identical gather/aggregate kernel work regardless of weight values; quadrature switches LocalIntegral from mean to weighted-sum aggregation, so this is the production code path (design-review FIX 1, false-finding F3)
pre-declared fidelity criterion (design-review FIX 2): the stage split passes if split_vs_e2e.max_abs_diff <= 0.02 * e2e median for that arm; threshold and pass/fail recorded per arm

neighbour band: target uncapped Poisson mean 400 per supernode, realised mean must land in [300.0, 512.0]; derived from the physical 0.1 m ball over an ~5-10 m^2 car surface with 100k points (scaled frame), which spans roughly 300-600 - the band records the mid estimate; B-stage cost scales ~linearly with the realised edge count
geometry tuned for N_g=100000; the smoke run uses the same geometry at N_g=2000 so its realised mean neighbours is ~8 and outside the band (wiring test only)

geometry.shape: prolate spheroid surface (stretched ellipsoid), longest side 2.0
geometry.n_points_drawn_uniform: rejection sampling on the ellipsoid surface
geometry.supernodes: 32000 drawn without replacement from the cloud
